column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules for MedSecure (Step 8).
# Rules not listed here default to WARN. FAIL = the pipeline stops and the
# --- Must never regress: security headers and information leaks -> FAIL ---

column3: (Re-examine Cache-control Directives) PHI must never be cached
(Information Disclosure - Sensitive Information in HTTP Referrer Header)
(Server Leaks Version Information via "Server" HTTP Response Header Field)
(Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s))
(PII Disclosure) patient data must never appear in unauthenticated pages
(Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens) the API authenticates with a Bearer token in the Authorization header and sets no cookies, so cross-site requests carry no credentials - CSRF does not apply
